author: context-engineering-agent
phase: Phase 7 - Agent-Task Routing (AR.3 per-story context window design)

classification_model.name: Bell-LaPadula classification-ceiling
classification_model.rule: No story's context window may include Zone 2 (Episodic) or Zone 5 (Entity) content bearing PII unless the story itself is security-cleared. No Sprint 1 story is security-cleared for raw PII read access. Where a story's implementation reasoning needs to reference Zone 2/5 content shape, a redacted/pseudonymized synthetic example is substituted for any real or realistic PII value.
classification_model.zone_5_note: Zone 5 (Entity Memory) is out of Sprint 1 scope per backlog_draft.json future_sprints_backlog (FR-005). No Sprint 1 story context window touches Zone 5; the ceiling is recorded as N/A-not-yet-applicable rather than omitted.

context_windows.title: Memory Orchestrator core facade and unified context-assembly API
context_windows.pii_note: Orchestrator owns no persistent zone data (application layer only, HLD 3.1). No Zone 2/5 content enters this context window; nothing to redact.

context_windows.title: Working Memory zone (Zone 1) - TTL-primary scratch context
context_windows.pii_note: Zone 1 is scratch/TTL context, not Zone 2/5. No classification ceiling triggered; content is transient session context, no PII redaction required for this window.

context_windows.title: Episodic Memory zone (Zone 2) - chronological recency store
context_windows.pii_note: Zone 2 is the flagged PII-bearing zone (Bell-LaPadula ceiling). This story is NOT security-cleared. Only the schema shape and index/query decisions are admitted to context (chronological order, decay attribute, keyset pagination); no example conversational content is included. AC-002-DPDP-1 is included as a REDACTED requirement statement only (erasure/purpose-limitation obligation text), with all example PII values stripped and replaced by placeholder tokens such as <PII_EXAMPLE_REDACTED> where illustration is needed. DPDP erasure IMPLEMENTATION is out of this story per AR1-G3 (review-only, security-defense-architect consult) - the context window therefore excludes any crypto-shredding mechanism detail beyond the pointer to AC-013, which is not itself dereferenced here.

context_windows.title: Zone 2 capacity cap and MaxAge forced-archival backstop (OAQ-4)
context_windows.pii_note: This story evicts PII-bearing Zone 2 items and is P1-gated (security-defense-architect, Maker-Checker). Context window carries the eviction-ranking and config-surface mechanics only (MemoryScore ordering, cap/MaxAge config), never raw evicted item content. AC-002-CAP-DPDP-1 is included as a REDACTED requirement statement with cross-zone consistency language intact but no PII example values. The implementing agent (python-backend-engineer) is not security-cleared; the reviewer's scope note is included so the implementer knows what the reviewer will check, without granting the implementer PII read access it does not have.

context_windows.title: Provenance/Audit zone (Zone 7) - source, confidence, edit history
context_windows.pii_note: Zone 7 stores source attribution and edit-history METADATA about facts written from any zone, including Zone 2. This context window admits only the provenance schema (source_type, confidence, hash chain, item_id pointer) - it never includes the underlying Zone 2/5 fact content the provenance record points to. Any illustrative record uses a pseudonymized item_id and a placeholder source_type; no example resembles a real conversational fragment.

context_windows.title: Cross-cutting provenance write-path enforcement (WAL/outbox gate)
context_windows.pii_note: The gate operates on write-path CONTROL METADATA (source_type resolvability, 422 contract) across all Sprint 1 zones including Zone 2, but never needs to inspect payload content to enforce the gate. Context window is scoped to the control-plane contract only; no zone payload examples (PII or otherwise) are included.

context_windows.title: Retrieval-Index zone (Zone 6) - hybrid vector + lexical index
context_windows.pii_note: Zone 6 indexes Zones 2-5, 7, 8 (Zone 1 excluded, HLD 3.7), so its index necessarily derives from Zone 2 content. Context window admits only VECTOR/EMBEDDING-LEVEL and index-structure detail (HNSW params, BM25, RRF fusion, per-tenant partitioning, cache-key prefixing) - never the underlying source text used to produce an embedding. No example embedding is paired with example raw PII content; illustrations use an opaque pseudonymized item_id only. This is the highest-risk story for indirect PII leakage via example content because it sits directly on top of Zone 2, so the redaction is applied strictly.

context_windows.title: Memory Score computation engine (six-term formula)
context_windows.pii_note: MemoryScore is computed from numeric term inputs (Recency, Frequency, Importance, UserAffinity, TaskRelevance, ProvenanceConfidence) sourced from Zones 2, 6, 7. Context window carries only the formula, weight/threshold config surface, and term-normalization contract - no example item whose score is being illustrated includes real or realistic PII text; any worked example uses abstract term values (e.g. Recency=0.8) only.

context_windows.title: Rotation state machine - Active to Compressed (Archived deferred)
context_windows.pii_note: The rotation sweep transitions items (including Zone 2 items) by state, keyed on item_id and MemoryScore only. Context window excludes item payload content entirely - state-machine and scheduling logic never needs to read the item body, so no redaction substitution was even necessary beyond confirming the exclusion.

context_windows.title: ADR-012 deadline-invalidation wiring on non-Recency term mutation
context_windows.pii_note: Wiring touches a mutation SIGNAL (Frequency-on-access, ProvenanceConfidence-on-conflict, Importance-on-override), not zone payload content. Context window includes only the three named hook points and the O(log N) re-insert contract; no Zone 2 content, conflict text, or override rationale text is admitted as example material.

context_windows.title: SPIKE: Qdrant client library version/compatibility pinning validation
context_windows.pii_note: Pure client-library/version research and documentation; no zone payload, no PII, no code path is touched. Nothing to redact. Budget is smaller than any other Sprint 1 entry (3500 vs. a 5000 floor) because this story's real source list is genuinely thinner - no HLD Section 3/5/6 pattern content, no AC list beyond spike exit criteria - not a measured value like the other entries, a judgment call scoped to what this spike actually needs. Added 2026-09-18 closing a docs-drift gap found in a 57-artifact repo-wide audit.

summary.strictest_redaction: DASH-STORY-003 (direct Zone 2 owner) and DASH-STORY-007 (indexes Zone 2 content into embeddings) carry the strictest redaction discipline - both exclude raw/realistic PII text even from illustrative examples, substituting pseudonymized item_id placeholders.
summary.note_on_security_clearance: No Sprint 1 story is security-cleared for raw PII. Where a P1 reviewer (security-defense-architect, api-security-auditor) needs deeper access for its own review, that access is scoped to the reviewer's separate review context, not to the implementing agent's context window documented here.
